note: Chat stickers. To add one: put the image here (webp/png/svg/gif, square, ≤ 150 KB), add an entry to the list, e.g. { "id": "my-id", "file": "my-id.webp", "label": "Label" }, and add the same id on the server: insert into games.stickers(id, label, sort) values ('my-id', 'Label', 10); Only ids that exist on the server can be sent. While the list is empty the sticker button is hidden.
